title: Third Block "I Need U to Listen" To The New Stunning Single
htmlContent:
The American pop singer and composer Third Block has left fans in love with his newest song, "I Need U to Listen." He offers his listeners a unique and original experience and showcases his incredible vocal talent. The music has a great beat and is very inviting. 

It achieves a unique and enjoyable sound with electronic pop elements. With a very different and well-paced style, the track presents a distinct melancholy. But even so, its melody is catchy and makes you listen to that sound. 

If you like an excellent Dream Pop song's more melancholy and musical sound, you cannot fail to check out Third Block's new single. 

Stream "I Need U to Listen" on Spotify
